pages.title: Welcome to the hive
pages.text: Productive Bees Genesis connects Productive Bees bees and combs to Mekanism machines. Your first goal is a small manual line: power one Apiary, move its comb to one Centrifuge, and collect the result. After that works, continue to factories, AE2, and advanced upgrades.$(br2)Required: NeoForge, Productive Bees, Productive Lib, and Mekanism. AE2, Applied Flux, and Mekanism addons are optional integrations covered later.

pages.title: Guide book and updates
pages.text: Craft the guide with a book, honeycomb and an empty Bee Cage or Sturdy Bee Cage. Cages containing bees are rejected; unrelated components such as custom names do not disqualify an empty cage.$(br2)When updating multiplayer to 1.2.4, update clients and the server together so the bee editor uses the same communication version.

pages.title: Begin here
pages.text: Right-click a placed machine to open it. Shift-click usually moves a stack quickly. Insert a bee and its matching flower or pollen, connect FE, and leave room for both item and fluid outputs. JEI lists each bee's exact work condition.
